member.name: T:SysWeaver.AI.ComfyTaskWorkflow
member.summary: A ComfyUI workflow (API format) that has been analyzed for use with the task methods (TextToImage etc) of the . The analysis works on the node graph, so the workflow doesn't need any annotations: The output is the save / preview node (image, video or audio) that the workflow produces, nodes annotated with "#tag" are preferred. The task type is determined from the output and the load nodes (images to image / video), audio is classified as speech, music or sound using the names of the file, nodes, titles and inputs. Each parameter is mapped to the node inputs that holds the value (following links through primitive, constant, math, switch and reroute nodes), ex: the prompt is the text that ends up in the positive conditioning. Parameters can be mapped explicitly by annotating a node with a parameter name, ex: "$Prompt", "$Seed", "$Width", "$Height", "$Duration", "$Lyrics", "$Voice", "$EnhancePrompt" or "$Transparent". When a node is annotated, the heuristics are not used for that parameter. The workflow is uploaded to ComfyUI-Connect with annotations added for the mapped inputs (as "sw_[name]", and "sw_[name]_sized" if changing the size requires replacing links).

member.summary: Get a system prompt for an LLM that rewrites a user request (and any media details, such as the size or duration) into a prompt that is optimized for this workflow. The instructions include the model (family) and how to best prompt it, the task, the prefix / suffix to apply, how the negative prompt is handled, an example prompt (the default prompt of the workflow) and rules to only output the prompt. ([\$#!])([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)(?:\(([^)]*)\))?
Explanation:
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [!#$].
○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9A-Z_a-z] greedily at least once.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match '('.
○ 3rd capture group.
○ Match a character other than ')' atomically any number of times.
○ Match ')'.
